message:
test(ka-pc): the picker counts as visible only on the client area and the card this activation logged; it is captured with PrintWindow (Codex evidence candidate r2 V1)

The managed e2e's "a WGC capture shows the picker" passed two all-white captures (a whole-window color count: the title
bar alone gave 9 > 4). The cause is the capture, shown by ka_pc_wgc_offscreen_probe (no host or viewer): a fresh
activation window has no swapchain present yet, so the viewer draws the picker with GDI into its DC, and for a window
off every monitor WGC returns GDI content as white (even when it repaints during the capture), while a flip-swapchain
present comes back as drawn and PrintWindow returns the GDI content.

Now the picker is captured by PrintWindow(PW_CLIENTONLY | PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) and judged by ka_pc_e2e_picker_judge.hpp:
the picker background over most of the client area and the desktop card THIS activation logged drawn (its frame color
and a drawn inside); the card is pressed only on a visible picker. The frame after the selection (WGC) must be a
picture and not the picker. ka_pc_e2e_child_test: synthetic cases, and the two real white captures of 10-29 that the
old count passed are refused now. No product, UI, render seam or window placement changed. No e2e was run.
